h1: CRM setup, configured for how you sell
overview: We configure your CRM account so it follows your sales process instead of the default settings. That covers custom fields for the details you actually track, user accounts with the right permissions, contact and company layouts, and the basics such as time zone, currency and notifications. You finish with a short handover guide with screenshots, so anyone who joins your team knows where everything lives and how to enter a lead.

faq: Which CRMs can you set up?
We work in tools such as HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive and similar systems, inside your own account. Tell us which one you use. If you have not picked yet, start with CRM Selection.
No. You invite us as a user or admin in your CRM, and you can remove us any time. We never ask for your login details, and we only change what we agreed in writing.
Who pays for the CRM plan?
You do, directly to the CRM company. Some features sit on paid plans, so we tell you before we start if something we planned needs an upgrade. Our price covers the setup work only.
Can you start from an empty account?
Yes. If you have nothing yet, tick the box in the order form and we create the account under your business email and set it up from the first screen, then transfer ownership to you.
